description: Fifth Draken prototype; struck off after 655 flights in 1966 and passed to the Royal Institute of Technology where skin panels on the right side were removed for teaching. Ninth Draken test airframe; forward fuselage only mounted on a rocket sled and used for high-speed ejection-seat trials in the USA. Painted white with a dragon motif on the nose. On loan from Flygvapenmuseum (Statens forsvarshistoriska museer).
Withdrawn in 1977 after 1169 flying hours and taken over by Flygvapenmuseum the same year; on loan here since 2013. On loan from Flygvapenmuseum (Statens forsvarshistoriska museer).
